LibriVox recording of J.S. Bach, Volume 2 by Albert Schweitzer. (Translated by Ernest Newman.)
Read in English by LibriVox Volunteers.

Musical segments provided by: Devorah Allen, Jake Malizia, and Krista Zaleski.
